test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: For a frequency polygon:

options.text: frequencies are plotted against class boundaries
frequencies are plotted against class limits
class intervals are of equal width
cumulative frequencies are plotted against class limits

solution:
**Concept:**

A frequency polygon is a graphical representation of a frequency distribution. The key points to consider for constructing a frequency polygon include:

 
• The frequencies are plotted against the midpoints of the class intervals.
 
• The class intervals must be of equal width to ensure accurate representation of data.
 
• The points are connected by straight lines to form the polygon.</
